episode_summary: In this episode, Sarah Maslowski shares her insights on building a successful real estate business using YouTube. She emphasizes the importance of consistency and systematization in content production, offering strategies for maintaining a steady posting schedule even when life gets hectic. Key tactics include maintaining a video bank and using a two-week cycle for content planning and filming.
